title: Rich Ore Vein
description: Allow you to freely adjust the generation quantity of various ores (including ores in other mods).
body:
Allow you to freely adjust the generation quantity of various ores (including ores in other mods).

The default probability and quantity of mineral generation are 1.5 times, and you can use the command "/richore config" to open the configuration interface to modify this value.

![Config Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8730aad3247dd358d7c13e1e9b8dff9450a1153c_0.webp)

You can use command "/richore reload" to relaod config. After modifying the configuration file, it is necessary to re-enter the world to apply the changes.

The client is not necessary, but if you wish to modify the configuration from the client, installation is required.
